augmentation.description: Path to the context-slice markdown injected for this condition; blank = no augmentation (baseline).
augmentation.title: Augmentation

nonce_prefix.description: Prepend a unique comment line to the system prompt so each run defeats provider prompt-cache reuse.
nonce_prefix.title: Nonce prefix

shuffle_order.description: Randomize condition×repetition execution order to avoid ordering bias.
shuffle_order.title: Shuffle order

user_field_template.description: Reserved for v2 (not used in v1).
user_field_template.title: User field template

api_key_env_list.description: Reserved for v2 (not used in v1).
api_key_env_list.title: API key env list

test_command_patterns.description: Regexes matched against tool commands to count test runs (e.g. 'pytest', 'go test').
test_command_patterns.title: Test command patterns

shell_tool_names.description: Tool names treated as shell/command execution.
shell_tool_names.title: Shell tool names

read_tool_names.description: Tool names counted as file reads.
read_tool_names.title: Read tool names

search_tool_names.description: Tool names counted as code search (grep/glob/list).
search_tool_names.title: Search tool names

command_arg_keys.description: Tool-arg keys whose value holds the shell command (matched against test_command_patterns).
command_arg_keys.title: Command arg keys

agent.description: OpenCode agent profile name to run.
agent.title: Agent

command.description: Build/test command. Leave blank to auto-detect (gradle/maven/pytest).
command.title: Verify command

enabled.description: Run the build/test verification step after the agent finishes.
enabled.title: Enabled

timeout_s.description: Max seconds for the verify command.
timeout_s.title: Verify timeout (s)

fixture_path.description: Working tree the agent edits (the stripped project).
fixture_path.title: Fixture path

reference_path.description: Ground-truth tree for comparison (the original project).
reference_path.title: Reference path

task_prompt.description: Task instructions — inline text or a path to a .md file.
task_prompt.title: Task prompt

system_prompt.description: System prompt — inline text or a path to a .md file.
system_prompt.title: System prompt

model.description: Model identifier passed to OpenCode (e.g. opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free).
model.title: Model

output_dir.description: Directory where run artefacts are written.
output_dir.title: Output dir

min_seconds_between_runs.description: Throttle between runs to respect provider rate limits (0 = none).
min_seconds_between_runs.title: Min seconds between runs

target_file.description: File the target method lives in — optional, for analysis.
target_file.title: Target file

target_methods.description: Method names under test — optional, for analysis.
target_methods.title: Target methods
